module_placement_finding.finding: The CF1 architecture assumes the V30 module at T_S_module [[1,0,0,-24],[0,1,0,30],[0,0,1,61.6]]. results/mechanical/MODULE_POSE_NARROWPHASE_CF1.json rejects that pose for the module body: CLAMP_DUAL_BASE 384.10 mm3, CLAMP_DUAL_LID 18.82 mm3, POST_DUAL_0 9.00 mm3, POST_DUAL_1 9.00 mm3 (all PHYSICAL_GEOMETRY, all three states), plus envelope overlaps P60_REFERENCE_B 66.76 mm3, PROP_DATA_ROUTE 263.10 mm3 and WP10_RRC3570_4_D_MAX_ENVELOPE 90412.63 mm3. results/mechanical/MODULE_POSE_LOCAL_SEARCH_CF1.json: none of 16 translations (dy 0..-6, dz 0..+6 mm) is physically clear; -Y trades the clamp base for RB303, +Z meets RB_upper_beam_20; the smallest physical overlap is 139.84 mm3 at dy -6 (CLAMP_DUAL_BASE 54.0 + RB303 85.8). For context, the V30 accepted pose is itself REJECTED_SAVED_GEOMETRY_INTERFERENCE in coupled_closure/HOST_NARROWPHASE.json (18 collisions per state) and the three V33 shortlist poses are all acceptable_clearance_candidate=false; no exactly clear module pose exists in the tree.
module_placement_finding.disposition: MODULE_POSE_REJECTED; a local relief on CLAMP_DUAL_BASE / the carrier corner or a change of module x is a design change outside CF1. The straps, lug patches and thermal screen are defined for the nominal pose and must be re-derived if the pose moves.

source_discrepancy.finding: The same STEP (sha256 eafde8dd343768f5...) is placed at two different poses: MAIN_INPUT_PLACEMENT_BOUNDS_V27.json T_S_step translation (-115, 39, 14) with a 90 deg rotation (bbox S x -152.5..-77.5, y -6..84), versus thermal/RADIATOR_OBSTACLE_BOUNDS.json translation (10, -48, 14) unrotated (bbox S x -35..55, y -85.5..-10.5). The CF1 -Y strap was kept above S z 35 so that it clears the RADIATOR_OBSTACLE_BOUNDS placement (top S z 34) as well; the narrowphase parent only knows the V27 placement.
source_discrepancy.disposition: OPEN_UPSTREAM; both placements avoided by CF1, neither is adjudicated here
